title: The Impossible Kitchen
author: Mara Crane
blurb: Ada Nakamura, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
